description: Return all stored explicit reference DOIs and indexed citing records by default, with an optional smaller limit for a visible record ID. These source-derived links are incomplete and are not proof of scientific support, criticism or trial/result identity.

id.description: The numeric string ID returned by search, not a DOI or URL.

limit.description: Omit or use all for every match. A positive integer requests an optional smaller result set.
